layers.1_strategy_reachability_gate: analysis/strategy_reachability_gate.py clears trade_ready/entry/stop/targets for any non-reachable strategy before a decision ever reaches the paper layer (verified in tests/test_strategy_quarantine_registry.py).
layers.2_registerable_paper_setup_geometry_gate: paper_testing/derived_setup_tracker.py:registerable_paper_setup requires trade_ready, valid invariants, setup_id, buy/sell direction, entry, stop, tp1, positive risk, tp1_rr>=1.5, and a non-terminal timing_state. Deliberately strategy-agnostic -- it verifies plan COMPLETENESS, not strategy eligibility (that's layer 1's job); tests/test_smc_structural_target_repair.py::test_setup_constructor_geometry_is_symmetric_for_registered_setup_names exercises this as a pure geometry-construction check across setup shapes and would break if strategy-eligibility were added here, so it was deliberately left alone.
layers.3_database_uniqueness_constraints: paper_testing/derived_paper_store.py: paper_setups.setup_id is UNIQUE, paper_decisions.dedupe_key is UNIQUE -- duplicate registration is rejected at the SQLite layer regardless of application-level bugs.

evidence: data/derived_paper_testing.db's byte checksum has changed since the Phase 1 backup, but this is the independently-running live backend process (pid confirmed running since before Phase 1) organically recording real periodic analysis -- paper_decisions rows are timestamped ~5-10 minutes apart matching live polling cadence, not a burst consistent with a test run. No Phase 2 code or test wrote to this file; schema and existing rows are untouched, only new rows were appended by normal live operation.
